engine_wire.request: ContextStoreRequestV1 {schema_version: 1, transport_version: 1, engine_interface_version: "1.0.0", project_id?, tenant_id?, task_id?}

invariants: every read is confined to one tenant/project scope; task_id is required for lineage and refused for evidence
unmeasured quality or security carries no counts; measured carries all of them
accepted + rejected = samples > 0; overrides and token samples never exceed samples
runtime signal counts never exceed their attributed tasks (signal_samples <= samples); absent counts are zero
tokens only with token samples; delivered tokens never exceed original
records strictly sorted by (workload, strategy, day); evaluations one per strategy, sorted
an evaluation names a known strategy, has ci_low <= ci_high and margin >= 0, and is powered only with pairs
a ledger error goes with the ledger_unverified gap; an unverified delivery with the delivery_unverified gap
a verified delivery has a summary and no error; an unverified one an error and no summary
gaps never repeat; a lineage without gaps is complete
